victory_arms_up.tags: victorious, both arms raised high, fists clenched, standing tall, head tilted up, chest out, from front, full body
victory_arms_up.note: Victory: both wrists well above the head line, feet planted wide; reads as triumph from the front.

uppercut_rising.tags: uppercut, rising punch, from below, dynamic angle, bent knees, twisted torso, motion lines, action
uppercut_rising.note: Uppercut: rear arm coiled low then whipping up; body compressed, weight on the back leg.

kick_side_high.tags: side kick, high kick, one leg raised, kicking, from side, full body, dynamic, action, foreshortening
kick_side_high.note: Side kick: kicking leg near-horizontal at hip height; supporting leg slightly bent, torso leaning away.

superhero_landing.tags: superhero landing, crouching, one fist on ground, dust, three-point landing, from front, low angle, action, dynamic pose
superhero_landing.note: Three-point landing: crouched low, one fist to the floor, other arm flared wide for balance.

dash_running_blur.tags: running, sprinting, full speed, motion blur, from side, leaning forward, speed lines, action
dash_running_blur.note: Sprint: torso leaned well past the hips, trailing leg kicked back, arms pumping opposite the legs.

sword_rest_shoulder.tags: holding sword, resting blade on shoulder, relaxed stance, three quarter view, full body
sword_rest_shoulder.note: Blade-on-shoulder idle stance: front arm relaxed, rear arm holding the hilt near the collarbone.

home_wave_hello.tags: waving, one hand raised, friendly, standing weight shift, smiling, three quarter view, full body, casual
home_wave_hello.note: Wave hello: raised hand tilted slightly, weight over one hip, other hand relaxed at the side.

home_sit_couch_lean_back.tags: sitting on couch, leaning back, relaxed, one arm along the backrest, legs crossed, from front, three quarter
home_sit_couch_lean_back.note: Couch lean: hips set low, knees together and crossed, spine open behind the shoulders.

studio_arms_crossed.tags: arms crossed, confident, standing, from front, chest out, full body, portrait distance, studio light
studio_arms_crossed.note: Arms crossed: forearms stacked over the chest line; a quietly certain wide stance.

studio_hand_in_pocket_lean.tags: hand in pocket, leaning against wall, one knee bent, relaxed, from side, three quarter, full body
studio_hand_in_pocket_lean.note: Wall lean: shoulders back against the surface, one heel hooked on the wall, hand buried in pocket.

studio_look_back_over_shoulder.tags: looking back, over shoulder, walking away, three quarter back view, from behind, coat, full body
studio_look_back_over_shoulder.note: Over-shoulder glance mid-stride: hips away from camera, chest twisted toward the lens.

portrait_hand_hip_contrapposto.tags: standing, contrapposto, one hand on hip, hip cocked, from front, waist up, portrait, elegant
portrait_hand_hip_contrapposto.note: Contrapposto with hand on hip: hips counter-tilted to the shoulders; a calm pose at portrait distance.

portrait_point_away.tags: pointing, extended arm, gesturing offscreen, three quarter, from front, expression, upper body
portrait_point_away.note: Pointing offscreen: dominant arm at shoulder height, other arm easy; sell direction with the head.

portrait_thinking_pose.tags: hand on chin, thinking, pensive, three quarter, portrait, waist up, standing
portrait_thinking_pose.note: Thinking: hand to the chin, other arm folded beneath the working elbow.

outdoor_tree_pose_yoga.tags: tree pose, yoga, one leg raised, balance, standing, calm, from front, full body
outdoor_tree_pose_yoga.note: Tree pose: one foot pressed to the inner thigh, arms folded overhead on inhalation.
